source.rationale:
TWIN CONTRACT. dym-transform and dym-transform-partial are byte-identical apart from the `promotion` DOMAIN_PROBE entry (and two comment rules), so every behaviour that is not promotion-specific MUST hold identically on both. Ported deliberately rather than left to the twin: this repo has been bitten before by a fork asserted to be identical that had quietly drifted, and a rule proven on only one copy is a rule the other copy is free to lose. Same inputs, same expected output as dym-transform/HC-picker-census-skips-options-without-a-uuid.json — if the two ever disagree, one of these two fixtures fails.

Behaviour under test: The picker census counts an option only when it has BOTH a code and a UUID-shaped uuid. Requiring both to be missing instead would fold `undefined` into the uuid set, turn a perfectly ordinary duplicate line into a cross-company ambiguity, and silently unprobe the code. Here SRTA appears twice — once properly, once without a uuid — and must still be probed.
